definitions.gloss: consignee; recipient of goods; addressee (of a shipment)
definitions.explanation: The person or entity designated to receive shipped goods or cargo. A standard term in logistics, shipping, and trade documentation.

examples.japanese: {荷受人|にうけにん}の{名前|なまえ}を{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check the name of the consignee.

examples.japanese: {荷受人|にうけにん}が{不在|ふざい}のため、{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ち{帰|かえ}った。
examples.english: The package was taken back because the recipient was not present.

examples.japanese: {送|おく}り{状|じょう}には{荷送人|にだしにん}と{荷受人|にうけにん}の{両方|りょうほう}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please write both the sender's and the consignee's addresses on the shipping document.

notes:
Composed of {荷|に} (cargo, goods), {受|うけ} (receive), and {人|にん} (person). A term from logistics and shipping used on delivery slips, invoices, and trade documents. While {受取人|うけとりにん} is more common in everyday contexts, {荷受人|にうけにん} is the standard term in commercial shipping and freight.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷受人|にうけにん}{住所|じゅうしょ}: consignee's address
- {荷受人|にうけにん}{不在|ふざい}: consignee absent
- {荷受人|にうけにん}{払|ばら}い: freight collect (consignee pays)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受取人|うけとりにん}: recipient — more general; used for packages, letters, and money
- {届|とど}け{先|さき}: delivery destination — refers to the address rather than the person
- {荷送人|にだしにん}: shipper/consignor — the person who sends the goods (the counterpart)
